title: Object Use Findings
description: Per-object usage classification findings produced by AccessHarvester identify-usage.

database.description: Name of the harvested Access database (without path or extension).

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the file was generated.

excludedObjects.description: Object names excluded via --exclude-cleanup (Passes: true in the cleanup checklist). These objects are not present in the objects array.

objects.description: One finding per non-excluded, non-system object in the harvested database.

objectName.description: The Access object name exactly as it appears in the database.

confidence.description: Classification confidence: >=0.8 High, 0.5-0.8 Medium, 0.2-0.5 Low, <0.2 Unknown.

usageSummary.description: One-sentence description of how the object is used, suitable for display as ItemLabel in the uat-checklist-editor checklist.

signals.description: One entry per signal type evaluated. Includes both fired and not-fired signals so readers can see what was checked.

questions.description: Clarifying questions generated for this object, one per fired uncertainty signal.

signalType.description: Which signal family produced this entry. See strategy doc §3.

fired.description: True if this signal type produced any evidence for this object.

evidence.description: Specific evidence values: table names, object names, SQL fragments, or relationship identifiers. Empty when fired=false.

questionText.description: The clarifying question to display in the checklist step.

uncertaintySignal.description: Which uncertainty signal triggered this question. See strategy doc §5-6.
